bears_on_nothing_ledger.policy_title: Launch Review of Nighttime Economy in England
bears_on_nothing_ledger.why: This policy commits only to launching a review — a process output, not a substantive intervention. It produces no concrete change to any indicator across any fundamental: no planning rules changed, no licensing regime altered, no taxes cut or raised, no workers' rights affected, no specific funding committed. Until the review produces actionable recommendations that are adopted, there is nothing material to score against any fundamental. Logged as analysed, bears on nothing material.
